fact: BCRG Decision D/2015/002/CAM of 31 March 2015 classes e-money institutions as financial institutions that need a licence from the BCRG's approvals committee, and Decision D/2015/008/CAM of 3 June 2015 sets their minimum capital at 2 billion GNF.
title: Finances : Maître Fodé Mourana Soumah décrypte le régime juridique de la monnaie électronique en Guinée
